tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. The cream of a field-book page; in dark, burnt umber at night.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, table headers, sidebars sitting on paper.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on paper or paper-raised (11:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata, dates, units on paper (5:1 light, 7:1 dark; 4.6:1 on paper-raised).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules, table gridlines, dividers. Decorative only; not a control border.

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour: iron-oxide staining. Primary buttons, links, key callouts; also errors. Paper text on rust passes 5:1.

tokens.name: pine
tokens.usage: Secondary accent: forest on the ridge. Success states, secondary actions, map legend for vegetation (6:1+ on paper).

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: Sandstone and dry grass. Highlights, warnings, chart fills. Never text on paper in light theme (2.3:1); text on ochre uses ink-on-ochre.

tokens.name: ink-on-ochre
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ochre fill: dark in both themes (5.6:1 light, 8:1 dark).

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Cold water and shale. Info states, water features in figures, a third chart series (5.3:1 on paper, 4.8:1 on paper-raised; 7:1+ in dark).

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Lichen tint. Quiet highlight behind notes or selected rows; ink text on it.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Report covers, page titles and the logo name, in Alegreya SC. Write in sentence case. One per page.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings, in Alegreya SC. Write in sentence case; the face turns lowercase into small caps.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Sub-sections and card titles, in Alegreya SC.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Core recovered at 94% through the skarn interval.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, column headers, tags. Set in capitals.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: contact sharp — check strike again tmrw
styles.usage: Margin notes and annotations on figures. Sparingly: never for body text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value; icon to text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and table-cell padding; gap between related items.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks in a section; field-book grid pitch.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between sections; page margins on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Tables, rules, strata bands, full-bleed images. The default.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags: just off sharp, like a worn edge.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and panels. The largest radius in the system.

roughness.note: How much a hand-drawn shape departs from a perfect one. Applies to shapes, rules, dots and figures only; never to text or to control edges that must look clickable.

tokens.name: rough-wobble
tokens.usage: Peak drift of a freehand line (outlines, sketches) from its true path, over long waves (~150px). Not for strata: those are ruled straight, with variation only at the stroke ends.

tokens.name: rough-displace
tokens.usage: SVG feDisplacementMap scale for the barely-ragged edge (feTurbulence fractalNoise, baseFrequency 0.04, 2 octaves). Use 0.5 on small icons.

tokens.name: rough-frequency
tokens.usage: feTurbulence baseFrequency paired with rough-displace. Higher reads as grainier and dry-brushed; keep 0.03 to 0.06.

tokens.name: rough-overshoot
tokens.usage: How far a traced line runs past the corner it meets, like a sketch line. Vary each one by ±2px.

tokens.name: rough-jitter
tokens.usage: Random nudge on hand-drawn hatching and tick marks. Never on dot grids: those are printed, exact and identical.

opacity.note: Drawn imagery is translucent, like coloured pencil or alcohol marker, so it never shouts. Text and UI controls stay fully opaque.

tokens.name: opacity-marker
tokens.usage: One flat marker pass over a filled shape. Where passes overlap (1–5px seams) the colour builds to ~0.86; that seam is where the hand shows.

tokens.name: opacity-pencil-line
tokens.usage: Light pencil traces and outlines in drawn imagery (not text, not table rules).

tokens.name: opacity-dot-max
tokens.usage: Peak opacity of printed dot-paper grids, in their corner. Fade to nothing along an edge parallel to the slope of the cover title's line-ends.
